description.value: Mona Pizza is a Maple Ridge pizza restaurant best known as the home of Chicago-style deep dish pizza in the area, alongside specialty pizzas, chicken wings, oven-baked pasta, fresh salads, and desserts. The restaurant caters to a range of dietary needs, offering vegan cheese, plant-based pepperoni, gluten-free crust, and keto options. Online ordering and delivery are available, and the menu is broad enough to satisfy a hungry group of touring cyclists.
